title: kanbus-api resolves tenant and project per request from verified identity instead of one deploy-time namespace
description:
Goal: one kanbus-api deployment serves every board in an environment. The board a request addresses comes from the request path. Whether the caller may use it comes only from the caller's verified identity. A new board (a new Chatticus bot) needs no redeploy. Decided 2026-10-20 (Ryan, via Chatticus): tenant = organization id, project = bot id, one deployment per environment.

Today (services/kanbus-api): Api is bound at startup to one namespace (Api::new(store, KANBUS_NAMESPACE), lib.rs ~296) or an allowlist (with_projects, max 8). The Lambda (src/bin/lambda.rs) reads KANBUS_NAMESPACE and admits users in one Cognito group (KANBUS_REQUIRED_GROUP, authenticate_cloud lib.rs ~176). Routes are /api/config, /api/issues[...], with ?project= or ?projects= selecting among the allowlist.

Design (one way only; no compatibility path for the old env vars or routes):
1. Principal. Authentication produces a verified Principal { actor: String, grants: Vec<Grant> }. A Grant is (tenant, ProjectGrant::One(project) | ProjectGrant::AllInTenant). Authorization is a pure function: principal.allows(scope).
2. Cloud (Lambda) users: grants come from the verified JWT claim cognito:groups. Every group named "kanbus:<tenant>/<project>" grants that board, and "kanbus:<tenant>/*" grants every board of that tenant. Other groups are ignored. No matching group means 403 forbidden. actor = sub. KANBUS_NAMESPACE and KANBUS_REQUIRED_GROUP are removed from the Lambda. Keep the existing claim parsing for array and string group claims, and the denied-membership diagnostic log.
3. Local binary: KANBUS_LOCAL_TOKEN still authenticates. The principal is granted exactly the one board the file store serves (KANBUS_ROOT plus KANBUS_TENANT and KANBUS_PROJECT, which replace KANBUS_NAMESPACE).
4. Routes: the board is in the path, mirroring the console's multi-tenant routes:
   GET /{tenant}/{project}/api/config
   GET|POST /{tenant}/{project}/api/issues
   GET|PATCH|DELETE /{tenant}/{project}/api/issues/{id}
   POST /{tenant}/{project}/api/issues/{id}/comments
   GET /{tenant}/{project}/api/issues/{id}/events
   Cross-board list within one tenant: GET /{tenant}/api/issues?projects=a,b (explicit names only; every name must be granted; bounded by the existing per-query budget, renamed from MAX_PROJECTS to MAX_PROJECTS_PER_QUERY and returning query_budget_exceeded as today). Remove the old /api/... routes and the project/projects query selection for single-board routes.
   Validate tenant and project with Scope::new rules. Invalid names return 400 invalid_request. An ungranted board returns 403 forbidden, and the response never reveals whether the board exists. A granted board with no .kanbus.yml returns the existing 503 configuration_missing.
5. Api no longer holds a fixed scope, namespace or allowlist: Api::new(store) plus per-request scope resolution. Idempotency receipts, journal and catalog stay keyed by scope, as today.
6. Out of scope here (separate stories): IAM/SigV4 service principals (kbs-f222b6ee; design Principal so it plugs in), provisioning a new board's .kanbus.yml through the API, and lifting the per-query budget (kbs-494ecd64).

Spec first: extend services/kanbus-api/features (writable_api.feature or a new board_scoping.feature) with scenarios for:
- two tenants and three boards served by one deployment;
- a user granted one board reads and writes it;
- a user is denied another board in the same tenant and any board in another tenant, with an identical 403;
- a tenant wildcard grant;
- a cross-board list across two granted boards, and the same list rejected when one board is not granted;
- invalid tenant or project names;
- a new board created in storage is usable immediately without restarting the service;
- the idempotent replay of an operation id is scoped per board.
Implement the steps in tests/behavior.rs and tests/support. Update tests/aws_api.rs (ignored live tests) for the new routes.

Docs: services/kanbus-api/README.md, AMPLIFY.md (group naming replaces KANBUS_REQUIRED_GROUP and KANBUS_NAMESPACE), docs/getting-started/cloud-database.md and EVIDENCE.md notes. Add a short migration note for existing single-board deployments (Prospectus): create the group kanbus:<tenant>/<project>, add members, remove the two env vars, and prefix client routes with /<tenant>/<project>.

Acceptance: all kanbus-api behavior tests pass (cargo test in services/kanbus-api, toolchain from its rust-toolchain.toml); cargo fmt and clippy -D warnings clean; no code path reads KANBUS_NAMESPACE or KANBUS_REQUIRED_GROUP.
